title: Spa Day for Two
description: A day at the spa for two: sauna, steam room and pool.
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code at reception. Book your slot by phone at least 2 hours ahead.
highlights: Sauna, steam room and pool in one place|Massage included from the 3-hour option|Ten minutes from Holesovice station
about_merchant: Lazne Holesovice is a neighbourhood bathhouse reopened in 2019 in a former brewery cellar. A small team runs three saunas, a steam room and a 15-metre pool.

title: Private Sauna Evening for Two
description: Private Finnish sauna for two with a cold plunge.
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code on arrival. Towels are included.
highlights: A whole sauna cabin to yourselves|Cold plunge right outside the door|Towels included
about_merchant: Sauna Stromovka sits at the edge of the park. Two wood-fired cabins are rented privately by the hour, each with its own plunge barrel.

title: Floatation Tank Session
description: A floatation tank session for one.
redemption_instructions: Enter the voucher code when you book online. Arrive 10 minutes early.
highlights: Private float room, nobody else around|First-timers get a ten-minute briefing|Shower, toiletries and earplugs provided
about_merchant: Float Letna has three float rooms above a quiet courtyard. The water is filtered between every session and kept at skin temperature.

title: Thai Massage
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code at reception.
highlights: Therapists trained in Chiang Mai|Traditional mat massage, no oil|Herbal tea after every session
about_merchant: Thai Garden Praha has been on Dukelskych hrdinu since 2012. Four therapists work in two quiet rooms at the back of the shop.
